The provision or reversal of this provision is made at the time of preparing the Consolidated financial statements and is recorded in the business management expenses of the period."}, {"bbox": [787, 98, 801, 301], "category": "Section-header", "text": "6. Recognition of loan receivables"}, {"bbox": [754, 127, 783, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Loans for the purpose of earning interest according to the contract between the parties but cannot be bought and sold on the market like stock."}, {"bbox": [645, 127, 751, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Loans are recognized at original cost. After that, the Board of Directors reviews all uncollected amounts to recognize provision for bad loans at the end of the year. Provision for bad loans is made for each loan based on the overage time to repay the principal according to the original debt commitment (not taking into account the debt extension between the parties), or based on the loss level expected. The difference between the provision made at the end of current year and the provision made at the end of the previous year is recognized as an increase or decrease in administrative expenses of the year. The reversed provision does not exceed the original cost."}, {"bbox": [608, 127, 637, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Loans are classified as short-term and long-term on the Consolidated Balance sheet based on the remaining maturities of the receivables at the Consolidated balance sheet date."}, {"bbox": [579, 98, 594, 318], "category": "Section-header", "text": "7. Principle of evaluating inventories"}, {"bbox": [423, 127, 572, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Properties acquired or being constructed for sale in the ordinary business of the Group, rather than to be held for rental or capital appreciation are recognized as inventories. Inventories are stated at the lower of original cost and net realizable value. Original cost of inventory includes the cost of land and construction expenses of infrastructure and apartments, direct expenditures and other overhead expenses incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition. Net realizable value is the estimated selling price in the normal course of business less the estimated costs of completion and saling expenses. Provision is made, when necessary, for obsolete, slow-moving, defective inventory items and when original cost is higher than net realizable value. The difference between the provision of this period and the provision of the previous period is recognized as an increase or decrease of cost of goods sold in the year."}, {"bbox": [395, 127, 410, 217], "category": "Section-header", "text": "Other inventories"}, {"bbox": [345, 127, 391, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Inventories are stated at original cost. The cost of inventories should comprise all costs of purchase, costs of conversion and other costs incurred in bringing the inventories to their present location and condition."}, {"bbox": [326, 127, 342, 540], "category": "Text", "text": "The cost of inventory at the year-end is calculated by weighted average method."}, {"bbox": [304, 127, 320, 441], "category": "Text", "text": "The Group applies the perpetual method to record inventory."}, {"bbox": [267, 127, 296, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Provisions for inventory obsolescence made at the end of the year are the excess of original cost of inventory over their net realizable value."}, {"bbox": [238, 93, 253, 447], "category": "Section-header", "text": "8. Recording principle of tangible and intangible fixed assets"}, {"bbox": [203, 127, 232, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "Fixed assets are stated at the original cost. During the using time, fixed assets are recorded at cost, accumulated depreciation and net book value."}, {"bbox": [150, 127, 197, 666], "category": "Text", "text": "During the using time, Group depreciates fixed assets into production and business expenses for fixed assets related to production and business. Intangible fixed assets such as land use rights are only depreciated for land use rights with a term."}, {"bbox": [47, 371, 62, 385], "category": "Page-footer", "text": "17"}]
